findings.passage: "And yes, one vote can make a difference. But we want that one vote to be in a situation where everybody has access to it. Not being hindered from voting," said Sen. Reggie Thomas
findings.note: Quoted in a LEX18 story (published 2020-04-15) on Senate debate before the veto override vote on SB 2 (photo ID to vote). He speaks of access to voting without hindrance.

findings.passage: “The American way is to encourage voting, not deter it,” Thomas said. “This bill will certainly deter people from voting.”
findings.note: Quoted on a WCBL Marshall County Daily post dated 2020-04-15 (no author credit on the page) about the SB 2 (photo ID to vote) veto override. The same post says he said the bill addressed a problem that did not exist and that there is no evidence of in-person voter fraud in modern times in Kentucky (that sentence is the writer's, not a quote).
